forceUpdate.title: Update required
forceUpdate.body: Please use the latest FlyFam version for new features. Older versions will be discontinued soon. iOS: update via TestFlight or the App Store. Android: update via Play Store closed testing; if you are not on the tester list, email flyfamapp@gmail.com to request an invite.

plans.legalSubscriptionTitle: Each plan determines how many followers can view a crew member's roster. Followers may have family or crew accounts. A follower can follow multiple crew members; each crew member manages their own subscription capacity.
plans.legalSubscriptionLength: Subscriptions renew monthly, or yearly if you choose a yearly product. Cancel anytime in App Store settings.
plans.legalSubscriptionPrice: You’ll see the charge on the App Store confirmation screen before paying. Need more seats? Upgrade to a larger package.
plans.legalAddonPrice: There is no separate add-on; follower capacity is included in the package you choose.
plans.autoRenewDisclaimer: Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Your subscription renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage it in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
